property_summary: General rule: after any successful fallback deposit at timestamp t, no further fallback call at any timestamp <= t+1 (the stored pastBlockTime t+1) can succeed — it must revert; the mutant removed the timestamp guard, so a call at exactly t+1 succeeds.
change_summary: Remove the `require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime);` check so multiple calls in the same block are allowed.
